_comment: Grafana SLOs for crok (SLO plugin API v1). stack.py slos creates each one after checking that its metrics exist; ${prom} is the stack's Prometheus datasource uid. Targets from the 2026-10 research report: success 97% and p90 time to first token 5 s per provider, 95% of turns completed.

slos.name: crok model calls succeed
slos.description: Share of crok's model calls without an error (interrupted calls left out), per provider, over 28 days. October baseline: OpenRouter 96.5%, Anthropic 97.8%, DeepSeek 100%.

slos.name: crok first tokens arrive within 5 seconds
slos.description: Share of crok's streamed model calls whose first token came within 5 seconds, per provider, over 28 days (the p90 target is 5 s). October p90: OpenRouter 5.1 s, Anthropic 3.8 s, DeepSeek 2.3 s.

slos.name: crok turns complete
slos.description: Share of crok turns that end with an answer rather than cancelled, cut off by --max-turns, stopped for repeating a call, or failed; experiment runs left out. Needs a crok release after 2.0.1 (crok_turns_total). 96.3% on one Mac in October.
